3.text: Physical silver is straightforward, offering a sense of control and security.
Choosing between silver bars and coins for your first purchase is a significant decision.

4.text: Home storage presents its own set of challenges.
Consider the fire risk - a fire could destroy your silver quickly.
A safe, dry cabinet away from direct heat sources is a good starting point.
Humidity can also damage silver over time, so look for a cabinet with good ventilation.

5.text: Keep them sealed to prevent air and moisture from reaching your silver.
